name: My 3-in-1 Girlfriend
summary:
My 3-in-1 Girlfriend is a dating-sim visual novel where you take the role of a high school student and mangaka, spending your days working side by side with your beloved assistant.

Chat with her, play with her, work together, or even flirt and get intimate! How you choose to spend your time together and develop your relationship is entirely up to you.

But there's a twist! This lovely assistant of yours has three distinct personalities, each with her own quirks, preferences, and struggles.

Getting along with all three won't be easy. But remember, they're all still part of the same girl.
